gaps.why_now: A dedicated Phase 11 build entry now keeps the landed gpio_wdt starter and the survey checkpoint reviewable together instead of letting the lane drift after the first driver scaffold landed.
The survey gate now acts as a freshness check around the landed gpio_wdt starter so the lane does not drift back to pre-driver assumptions or overclaim broader watchdog progress.

The survey note now records the landed gpio_wdt starter together with the bounded validation matrix, descriptor preflight checkpoint, timeout-property checkpoint, and the remaining registration, teardown, failure-mode, and hardware-backed validation work so the next Phase 11 step stays explicit without overstating broader watchdog progress.

The first gpio_wdt starter is now landed and models hw_algo parsing, heartbeat margin validation, bounded start or stop or ping transitions, a tiny probe-time summary, a nowayout-aware stop helper, a timeout-property checkpoint, and a registration-facing handoff summary without touching live GPIO or platform registration.

Dedicated Phase 11 tests now keep the toggle and level state transitions, heartbeat validation, always-running stop behavior, nowayout-aware stop outcomes, descriptor preflight ordering, timeout-property checkpoint ordering, and registration handoff bookkeeping honest around the landed simple-driver scaffold.

A bounded slice note records exactly what the gpio_wdt starter, probe-summary helper, descriptor preflight helper, timeout-property checkpoint, stop-policy helper, and registration handoff summary cover so later Phase 11 work can extend the model without reopening the starter contract.

The bounded validation matrix now records the shared Phase 11 replay path, the current property, startup, descriptor-preflight, timeout-property, runtime, and handoff evidence, and the remaining registration, teardown, failure-mode, and hardware-backed validation gap so the review packet keeps one truthful validation posture.

The lane now lands a tiny probe-time summary for always-running startup, requested GPIO line mode, and watchdog-core-facing bookkeeping so the starter describes more of gpio_wdt_probe() before any live GPIO or platform glue.
The starter now lands a tiny nowayout-aware stop helper so review can distinguish watchdog-core stop blocking from hardware always-running behavior before any live GPIO or platform glue.

The starter now adds a tiny registration-facing handoff summary so review can see whether startup state, stop policy, timeout init, and reboot bookkeeping reach watchdog-core registration before any live GPIO or platform glue.

The starter now adds a tiny descriptor preflight summary so review can see the exact devm_gpiod_get() flag choice and the fact that descriptor lookup still sits before timeout parsing, always-running bookkeeping, and the registration-facing handoff without claiming live GPIO acquisition.

The starter now adds a tiny timeout-property checkpoint so review can see that hw_margin_ms stays required and bounds-checked after descriptor lookup but before always-running bookkeeping, watchdog_set_drvdata(), and the registration-facing handoff, while invalid timeout values still block those later handoffs.

Platform-driver registration, GPIO descriptor acquisition, watchdog core registration, teardown and failure-mode parity, and hardware-backed validation remain blocked until the lane grows a real registration-facing scaffold that bridges the landed summaries to live GPIO and watchdog-core execution.
